# TimeDoco — Privacy-First Time Tracker

> TimeDoco is a 100% client-side, privacy-first time tracking web application. Data is stored strictly on-device in browser IndexedDB with no account, server, telemetry, or tracking.

## Core Pages & App

- [Landing Page](https://lukeafullard.github.io/TimeTag/): Feature breakdown, Toggl/Harvest privacy comparison, and overview of client-side tracking.
- [TimeDoco Web App](https://lukeafullard.github.io/TimeTag/app/): The full time tracking application interface (timer, timesheet matrix, analysis/PDF reports, grouping management).
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://lukeafullard.github.io/TimeTag/faq/): Questions and answers regarding IndexedDB local storage, PDF/CSV/ICS exports, multi-currency options, and offline PWA capability.
- [Blog Index](https://lukeafullard.github.io/TimeTag/blog/): Articles and guides for contractors, freelancers, and privacy advocates.

## Articles

- [Why Client-Side Privacy Matters for Contractors](https://lukeafullard.github.io/TimeTag/blog/why-client-side-privacy-matters/): Deep dive into client data confidentiality and zero cloud vulnerability.
- [Guide to Tax and Multi-Currency Reporting](https://lukeafullard.github.io/TimeTag/blog/tax-and-currency-reporting-guide/): How TimeDoco handles tax inclusive/exclusive configurations and unrounded CSV exports for accounting software.
